requirements.parent: Probe reads parent syscon regmap; exact parent/child SoC match added by bounded provider.patch.
requirements.legacy_infracfg: Nonzero masks on IDs0/4/6 require the intended INFRACFG map.
requirements.access_controllers: MT8163 num_bus_prot_blocks defaults0; core modern mode requires count equality, so nonempty access-controllers fails.
requirements.domain_supply: MTK_SCPD_DOMAIN_SUPPLY absent; core does not request domain-supply regulators.
requirements.hierarchy: Captured and legacy MFG child under MFG_ASYNC; node IDs must be unique.

limits: Active-wakeup and MFG clock placement differences remain unqualified.
Generic schema and topology checks do not validate voltage, timing or recovery after failed boot.
Captured-topology guard intentionally requires all eight nodes; generic bindings may permit other valid subsets.
